asked: # GitHub App for the whole stack: one-click setup, tokens that never die (Brett, Nov 1 ~4 AM) Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md, _claude/persona.md. Opus, one session. Git login works: plain `git push`. Never print secrets (private keys, client secrets, tokens) anywhere: logs, reports, commits, screenshots. Why: personal tokens keep dying (401s, 403s on the banner), and the current fine-grained token can't create repos (the axp-backup build at /root/axf-builds/axp-backup is waiting on 3 private repos: axp-xchat, axp-devstudio, axp-demo). Brett wants this fixed for good. ## 1. One-click setup (GitHub App Manifest flow) - Console page (behind the existing auth wall, admin only): Settings > GitHub > 'Create GitHub App'. It POSTs a manifest to https://github.com/settings/apps/new (personal account MossesX): name 'AmberX AXF Bot' (add suffix if taken), homepage the console URL, redirect/callback to the console, no webhook needed (or webhook off), public: false. - Permissions (repository): Administration RW, Contents RW, Pull requests RW, Actions RW, Workflows RW, Issues RW, Checks R, Commit statuses R, Metadata R. - Callback: exchange the code (POST /app-manifests/{code}/conversions), store app id, slug, client id, client secret, private key PEM and webhook secret in /opt/axf/.axf-console/github-app/ (dir 700, files 600, root-owned), never in git. Then send Brett to the install page (https://github.com/apps/<slug>/installations/new) with 'All repositories'. Detect the installation id after install (GET /app/installations with an app JWT). - Also offer 'Authorize as Brett' (OAuth user-to-server via the same app, with refresh tokens, stored the same way): needed because INSTALLATION tokens cannot create repos on a personal account; user access tokens from the app with Administration write can (POST /user/repos). Refresh automatically (8 h access / 6 month refresh); banner when refresh fails. ## 2. Token broker - framework/cli/github-token.mjs (+ a tiny Python twin for the console server if it needs it): `installation` -> mints a JWT from the PEM, exchanges for an installation token, caches it (refresh at 50 min), prints it only to stdout for callers; `user` -> the refreshed user access token. - /usr/local/bin/axf-git-cred: use the installation token first, then the old GITHUB_TOKEN as fallback. `gh`: wrapper or GH_TOKEN via a helper so gh uses the app too. Keep the old token working as fallback until Brett deletes it. - Point every GitHub caller at the broker: push banner, live-key-checks, activity banner GitHub part (the 403s), build_land/build_start paths, the console updater, CI-status reads. Repo creation (`axf repo create <name> --private`) uses the user token. - axHub's github connector (MossesX/axHub, packages/connectors or the rest service config): add app-based auth via the same broker or its own JWT exchange; clone axHub next to the worktree, test (pnpm test, Node 22 via docker node:22), push its main, redeploy through Coolify the same way earlier builds did (token saved in the console, never printed). If that's too big, leave axHub on the old token and banner it as a follow-up. ## 3. Health + banner - health@1 check: app key valid, installation present, installation token mints, user token refreshes, rate limit remaining. Red banner with the exact fix if any fail. Old-token expiry warning. - After setup works: re-run the axp-backup push automatically (create the 3 private repos with the user token, then `bash /root/axp-backup/bin/backup.sh` or whatever finish script that build left; read /root/axf-builds/axp-backup/axp-backup.log and /root/axp-backup/REPORT.md first). Never commit secrets; the backup's own secret scan must pass. Framework controls + theme/scale tokens only. Tests: manifest generation, callback exchange (mocked GitHub), file perms, JWT + token cache, git credential helper order + fallback, user-token refresh, health check states. Local test block from .github/workflows/android.yml + theme/contr…

result.summary: GitHub App for the whole stack: one-click manifest setup (Settings > Plugins > GitHub), token broker framework/cli/github-token.mjs, console keeper on the installation token (old PAT fallback), git cred helper + gh wrapper installed on the VPS, health items, axf repo create, axp-backup finish creates its repos once authorized. axHub connector left as follow-up.
